title: Font tweaks
description: changes the font to a tweaked one
body:
Font Tweaks is a lightweight resource pack designed to subtly improve the way text looks across Minecraft without changing the game’s overall style.
This pack adjusts and refines the default font so that chat messages, signs, books, command output, item names, and other text elements become cleaner, smoother, and easier to read — all while staying faithful to the vanilla aesthetic.

Whether you’re typing in multiplayer chat, labeling your storage system, writing in a book, or browsing through tooltips, this pack gives every piece of text a more polished feel. It’s perfect for players who want a small quality‑of‑life upgrade that you immediately notice but never feels out of place.

Features:

Improved readability in chat

Cleaner text on signs and books

Subtle adjustments to glyph shapes

Vanilla‑friendly look and feel

Works seamlessly with most other resource packs

If you enjoy small visual improvements that make Minecraft feel smoother and more comfortable to play, this pack fits right in. Simple, clean, and easy on the eyes.
